route_contract.principle: AI/geometry provides shape, PSD provides skin, Godot renders. Face style must have zero drift from Live2D R19.

face_projection.anchor_meaning: painted eye-line midpoint px  <->  model point (0, z=1.66)

hard_constraints: Long hair must render complete: no holes/破面 (closed sweeps with fold audits).
3D head must align to Live2D R19 identity: maid headband, right-side blue bow, dark-blue-root to bright-blue-tip gradient, bangs over eyes, low half-hidden fin ears at eye height, small V chin.
Depth relation: the face IS the front of the head surface; hair grows on the scalp and overlaps the face rim (no helmet-over-recessed-face).

rounds.reason: built from scratch, not anchored to R19; all six identity features wrong

rounds.note: texture-reuse face projection worked, but structure was hair shell + recessed face ball; user rejected depth relation
single-surface head: face cap + skull blended in one closed mesh, per-polygon material slots, all locks grow on scalp surface

known_deviations_round3: cheek rim (|x| 0.20-0.25) transition ledge visible from side views
headband front edge still floats slightly
head-surface hair color uniform royal; add root-to-tip gradient
